startup-verband-logo.png.permission: PUBLISHED, not corresponded. The association publishes a member badge set for members to display, in its own public media library (https://startupverband.de/presse/mediathek/), as the download item "Logos 'Mitglied im Startup-Verband'" -> https://startupverband.de/fileadmin/startupverband/mediaarchiv/Logos_Mitglied_im_Startup-Verband.zip Retrieved 2026-09-12: HTTP 200, application/zip, 2698046 bytes, sha256 f1711a9add3d0789... The file displayed here is BYTE-IDENTICAL to "Logos Mitglied im Startup-Verband/Farbe/LogoMitgliedIm.png" inside that archive (sha256 8134b3f421ef3acb... on both sides), so the displayed bytes are the association's own published member badge rather than a copy of unknown origin. Measured limitation, stated rather than glossed: the badge is PUBLISHED for member use, but neither the media library, /mitglied-werden/, /members/mitglied-werden/, the press kit nor the Members Hub Nutzungsbedingungen state usage TERMS - all four were read on 2026-09-12 and none carries a logo clause. The permission rests on the act of publication for members, and the constraints below are therefore ours by default, not the grantor's by instruction. Granted 2026-09-12.
startup-verband-logo.png.usage_rules: Use as delivered. No recolour, no distortion, no crop. Preserve the intrinsic aspect ratio. The colour variant is used; the archive also ships white and black variants.
